issues.title: `inventory low` leaves out items at the threshold
issues.body:
`inventory low` leaves out an item whose quantity equals the threshold. With the sample `stock.txt` and `--threshold 5`, the hinge (quantity 5) is not listed. The README and the docstring of `low_stock` both say "at or below the threshold".

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `inventory low stock.txt --threshold 5` lists every item whose quantity is 5 or less.
- [ ] An item whose quantity is above the threshold is not listed.
